sloka: प्लक्षः च एव प्रभावः च मंत्रिणौ अर्थ धर्मयोः ।वक्तुम् उच्चावचम् प्राप्तम् लक्ष्मणम् तौ शशंसतुः ॥४-३१-४३॥
transliteration: plakṣaḥ ca eva prabhāvaḥ ca maṁtriṇau artha dharmayoḥ ।vaktum uccāvacam prāptam lakṣmaṇam tau śaśaṁsatuḥ ॥4-31-43॥

translations.english: On hearing Angada's words the two ministers named Plaksha and Prabhava who were perrmitted to have audience with the queens went to the harem on invitation from Angada. They reported to Sugriva about the arrival of Lakshmana who had come to speak to him about matters regading wealth and righteousness.
translations.hindi: उस महाकोलाहल को सुन सुप्रीब होश में आए । परन्तु उस समय सुग्रीब के नेत्र नशे से लाल हो रदे थे और पुष्पमाला उनके गले में सुशोभित हो रही थी । किन्तु वे उस समय घबडाए हूए थे
